description: This file defines a React functional component 'Timeline' for rendering an interactive timeline view, including bars representing actions, resources, and console messages, with support for user interactions like dragging, resizing, and selection. It also includes utility functions for timeline calculations.

methods.name: calculateDividerOffsets
methods.description: Calculates positions and times for timeline divider lines based on current view boundaries and width.

methods.name: timeToPosition
methods.description: Converts a timestamp to a pixel position within the timeline based on boundaries and width.

methods.name: positionToTime
methods.description: Converts a pixel position within the timeline to a timestamp based on boundaries and width.

methods.name: barTop
methods.description: Determines the vertical position for a timeline bar based on its type.
